teach_en: Like the k in 'sky': a k with no puff of air.
notes: From letters.csv C01 (ipa k: unaspirated; verified); wording by agent. Changed 2026-11-09 from 'a hard g' so the text reads correctly in both transliteration styles (user).

teach_en: As in the word 'no'. It sounds the same at the end of a word, as in 'sun'.
notes: From letters.csv C13 (ipa_initial = ipa_final n; verified); wording by agent. Taught with C13f as one card (same-sound pair; user 2026-10-24).

teach_en: At the end of a syllable, as in the word 'sun'.
notes: From letters.csv C13 (ipa_final n; verified); wording by agent. Shortened 2026-10-24.

teach_en: As in the word 'bit'. Written above the consonant, but said after it.
notes: From vowels.csv V04 pron_tip (verified); wording by agent. Shortened 2026-10-24.

teach_en: A k with a puff of air, as in the word 'kite'.
notes: From letters.csv C02 pron_tip (verified); wording by agent.

teach_en: A small mark written above the letter. It changes the melody of the word.
notes: From letters.csv T2 (verified: the mark changes the tone); wording by agent. The class rule is deliberately left out (user 2026-11-09).

teach_en: As in the word 'now'. Written in three parts around the consonant: before, above and after.
notes: From vowels.csv V35 pron_tip and pattern ເ◌ົາ (verified); wording by agent.
From letters.csv C23 pron_tip (verified: l as in 'law'); wording by agent.

teach_en: At the end of a syllable, a short w sound, as at the end of 'now'.
notes: From letters.csv C24 pron_tip (verified: at the end of a syllable a w glide as in 'now'); wording by agent.

teach_en: Like the a in 'father'. Written after the consonant.
notes: From vowels.csv V03 pron_tip (verified: long 'a' as in 'father') and its pattern; wording by agent.

teach_en: Like the um in 'hum'. Written with a small circle above the consonant and a stroke after it.
notes: From vowels.csv row V36 pron_tip (verified: 'um' as in 'hum') and its pattern; wording by agent.

teach_en: Like the a in 'cat', held long. Written before the consonant; it looks like two ເ side by side.
notes: From vowels.csv V15 pron_tip (verified: long 'a' as in 'cat') and pattern ແ◌; the look-alike remark is about the written shape only; wording by agent.
From letters.csv C14 pron_tip (verified: b as in 'boy'). Initial role only; its final sound (an unreleased p) is a later unit, so it is not mentioned. Wording by agent.

teach_en: A second tone mark, a small stroke above the letter. Words with this mark are said at a flat, middle pitch.
notes: From letters.csv T1 (verified: gives the mid tone for every class); 'flat, middle pitch' restates the mid tone without naming classes (decision 11). Wording by agent.

teach_en: Like the aw in 'law', held long. Just a small circle above the consonant, with no stroke after it.
notes: From vowels.csv V21 pron_tip (verified: long 'aw' as in 'law') and its pattern ◌ໍ; the 'no stroke after it' remark separates it from ◌ຳ (lesson 4) by its written shape only; wording by agent.
